newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 1997 CPI seen at 16.2 pct - banking poll.
newsitem.headline: Polish 1997 CPI seen at 16.2 pct - banking poll.

text.p: Polish bankers forecast year-on-year inflation at 16.2 percent in December 1997, compared with 15.3 in April, a monthly poll released on Tuesday by the private Pentor institute showed.
Last month Pentor's poll, conducted among over 200 bank managers, showed inflation at 16.6 percent at the end of 1997.
The government inflation target for December is 13 percent. A Reuter poll of banking analysts published earlier this month showed year-end inflation at 14.62 percent.
Pentor's poll showed that the zloty was expected to fall at end-1997 to 3.40 to the dollar.
The zloty was fixed at 3.24 to the dollar on Thursday.
